messages:
Lina: trying the quickstart with a service-account json and getting a 403. Console shows billing enabled for my org though. Any quick checks?

Tom: paste the error body? Also which env vars are you setting (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH)?

Lina: error body: {"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace requires billing enabled"}}. I set REDWOOD_API_KEY to the path of the JSON because sample README only said set API key.

Tom: ah that can be it. Service account JSONs are scoped to the org they were issued in. If you point the app at the JSON but the app expects a plain string key it may try the wrong workspace. Run `redwood whoami` or inspect the `client.getWorkspace()` to confirm which workspace the key belongs to.

Lina: ran `redwood whoami` and it returns workspace: "alpha-devops" for the service-account but my console billing is enabled only for "alpha-prod". Is there a way for the SDK to make this clearer? Right now node just throws a 403 without details.

sdk-bot: note: the API includes `type` in the JSON response. SDKs should map `billing_required` to a BillingRequiredError and include workspace info when available. Filing DX ticket.

Tom: additional gotcha: corp proxies can also mask headers and break auth (if you see ECONNRESET in curl test). Try NO_PROXY=api.redwood.dev or set NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS if your proxy intercepts TLS.

Lina: good call, curl to validate TLS showed a reset until I added NO_PROXY. After switching to the right service account (alpha-prod) and bypassing proxy it worked.

Docs: filing a docs tweak: quickstart should (1) clarify env var names for service-accounts vs secret keys, (2) add a preflight `GET /v1/workspace` to print workspace slug and billing state before calling the generation endpoint, and (3) add a short proxy troubleshooting note.

billing-bot: Service account `sa-alpha-02` belongs to workspace `alpha-devops` (billing disabled). Workspace `alpha-prod` billing enabled.

Tom: action items: SDK team to add billing_required mapping, docs to update quickstart README with explicit env var guidance and preflight snippet, and sample-app to exit with a clear message linking to https://console.redwood.ai/settings/billing when billing_required is returned. Lina, thanks for the repro steps. :thumbsup:
